Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Varun Subramanian. I am a 25-year-old architect living in Chennai. M/s Lotus Enterprises gave me a cheque for ₹8,25,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 94872 66753 or email varun.subramanian@example.in.
